_meta.note: Conviction tiers derived from the improvement-pass backtest: cost-adjusted expectancy (0.15% stock / 0.25% crypto round-trip), stability across the two 5-year stock halves, and sample size. Not re-derived live on every run — re-run the backtest scripts periodically and update this by hand if the picture changes.

momentum.reason: Stable across both 5y halves (0.18%->0.21%), but only 0.04% after cost — thin margin caps it below high.

golden-cross.reason: Stable direction but smallest sample of the three defaults (n=6935) and thinnest cost-adjusted margin (0.01%).

macd-bullish.reason: Largest sample (102k) and stable, but very redundant with other signals (high Jaccard overlap) and only 0.01% after cost.

vcp.reason: Weakened a lot from 3y (0.21%) to 10y (0.07%) and negative after cost.

cup-handle.reason: Went negative once cost was applied (-0.06%).

mean-reversion.reason: Sign flips between 5y halves (-0.51% then +0.44%) — not a real edge, regime-dependent.

ma-alignment.reason: Positive but thin (0.12% 10y) and highly redundant with near-52w-high/momentum.

ob-bullish.reason: Ported from a TradingView SMC indicator (src/smc.js). Best of all stock signals: stable both 5y halves (0.26%->0.17%), stays POSITIVE after cost in both (0.11%/0.02% — nothing else does), and low redundancy (<0.1 Jaccard) with momentum/cup-forming/golden-cross.

fvg-bullish.reason: Positive raw both halves (0.21%->0.09%) but cost-adjusted flips negative in the second half (0.06%->-0.06%) — same instability pattern as mean-reversion/volume-surge.

bos-bullish.reason: Same instability as fvg-bullish on stocks: cost-adjusted flips negative second half (0.06%->-0.05%). (Note: bos-bullish is HIGH tier for crypto — see below, doesn't transfer across markets.)

ob-bearish.reason: Negative both halves (-0.31%/-0.33% cost-adjusted), consistent with every other bearish signal in this bot.

ma-alignment.reason: 0.88% after 0.25% cost assumption, n=918, not among the highly-correlated pairs.

near-52w-high.reason: 0.79% after cost but smaller sample (n=261) than the two 'high' kinds.

cup-forming.reason: 0.44% after cost, n=441 — solid but well below the top two.

vcp.reason: 0.32% after cost but very high fire frequency (n=1345), likely redundant/generic.

bos-bullish.reason: 0.52% after 0.25% cost, n=464, low redundancy (<0.15 Jaccard) with the other 4 crypto defaults. Unlike stocks, this is the SMC kind that works for crypto — ob-bullish (best on stocks) tested -0.64% here.

ob-bullish.reason: -0.64% after cost on crypto despite being the best stock signal — asset classes don't transfer, do not enable here.

fvg-bearish.reason: -1.27% after cost, the worst of all SMC variants tested.

default.reason: No backtest entry for this kind — treat as unvalidated until it's run through the same pipeline.
